description: The records this search considered — every register and common-law entry, including ones the report does not name individually. Each carries the mark, owner and country, the classes, the register status, the source link, whether the provider record was actually retrieved (`retrieved`), and `superseded: true` if a later pass withdrew it. Use this to answer 'what exactly did you find, and who owns it?'. Filter with layer: register | common-law.

runId.description: The run's full runId (slug-date-codename) OR just its codename.
